_doc: Hand labels for owner scans (case ids are the anonymised hashes of scripts/dataset-export.ts; photos stay in the git-ignored .tmp/dataset). A label here replaces the diary save as truth, so scans the owner never saved (or saved wrong) are scored too. eval-scans.ts reads it on every run, so a dataset-export re-run does not lose it.
